invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
User.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
A product must have a price that is greater than or equal to zero.
A product must have a quantity that is greater than or equal to zero.
When searching for products by name, the search is case-insensitive and matches partial names.
When filtering products by category, only products belonging to the specified category are included.
When applying a maximum price filter, only products with a price less than or equal to the specified maximum are included.
When applying a minimum quantity filter, only products with a quantity greater than or equal to the specified minimum are included.
All filter conditions—name, category, maximum price, and minimum quantity—can be combined and applied simultaneously to the product list.
If no filters are applied, all products are returned.
